title: Rethinking Human Intent-to-CAD: Parametric CAD Model Generation via Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parametric Computer-Aided-Design (CAD) modeling from human intent remains challenging, particularly during the conceptual design stage, where design goals are expressed through incomplete and unstructured modalities (e.g., hand-drawn sketches and textual descriptions). In this work, we rethink the human intent-to-CAD pipeline and propose a unified method that directly maps multi-level human intents to executable codes, without assuming the prior existence of target CAD models. To support our study, we construct HiCAD, the first large-scale dataset aligning hand-drawn sketches, textual descriptions, and parametric CAD codes. Based on this, we introduce HiCAD, a two-stage framework comprising Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment to bridge the representational gap between heterogeneous inputs, and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning to enforce geometric and topological consistency. translated_title: 重新思考从人类意图到CAD：通过协作多任务对齐与空间感知强化学习生成参数化CAD模型
translated_abstract: 从人类意图生成参数化计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在概念设计阶段，此时设计目标通过不完整且非结构化的模态（例如手绘草图和文本描述）来表达。在这项工作中，我们重新思考了从人类意图到CAD的流程，提出了一种统一的方法，将多层次的人类意图直接映射为可执行代码，而无需假设目标CAD模型预先存在。为支持我们的研究，我们构建了HiCAD——首个将手绘草图、文本描述与参数化CAD代码对齐的大规模数据集。基于此，我们提出了一个两阶段框架，包含协作多任务对齐，用于弥合异构输入之间的表示差距；以及空间感知强化学习，用于强制保证几何与拓扑一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了……
tldr: 提出首个将手绘草图、文本描述与参数化CAD代码对齐的大规模数据集，并结合协作多任务对齐与空间感知强化学习的两阶段框架，无需已有目标CAD模型即可将多层次人类意图直接映射为几何与拓扑一致的可执行参数化CAD代码。
